bosses.name: Onyxia
bosses.general: Phase 1 on the ground: breath in front, tail sweep behind. Phase 2 (65%) she flies: whelps pour out and Deep Breath crosses the room. Phase 3 (40%): Bellowing Roar fears, lava cracks.
bosses.tank: Turn her so the raid stands at her flanks; in phase 3 Fear Ward and Tremor, take her back fast.
bosses.healer: Stand at her side, never in the breath line; Fear Ward the tank in phase 3.
bosses.dps: Flanks only. Phase 2: ranged on her, melee on whelps, run from Deep Breath. Phase 3: watch threat.
